payload.friendly_name: Step enhancements phase 2: compose checks and the effective-prompt read
payload.purpose_context: Phase 2 of the ADR-0066 service alignment (#424), split from mission adr-0066-step-enhancement-service-alignment-01M6ZRYK by operator ruling on 2026-11-09. It builds the compose-time refusals and the effective-prompt read on top of phase 1 (step enhancements held and checked at load) and of PR C of layer-merge-and-effective-reads-01M6R0J6, which makes a step enhancement able to be in force. It is blocked until both merge.
payload.purpose_tldr: The charter service refuses composes that would misplace a prompt fragment and serves the prompt a step really gets, with its fragments in order.
